Attack on Titan Filler List

(Shingeki no Kyojin)

Updated on January 4, 2024

Attack on Titan was an anime series that ran from 2013 to 2023. In total 89 episodes of Attack on Titan were aired. Attack on Titan has no reported filler.

The remnants of humanity are forced to live in walled cities in order to protect themselves from the Titans. The people's illusion of safety is shattered when the wall is breached and the battle with the Titans begins.
